quotations.old_english: Gif wén wíére ðæt hé ðǽr hwylce mihte deófle óþgrípan and tó Criste gecyrran
quotations.latin: si quos forte ex illis ereptos Satanae ad Christum transferre valeret

source_text: óþ-grípan to snatch away :-- Gif wén wíére ðæt hé ðǽr hwylce mihte deófle óþgrípan and tó Criste gecyrran si quos forte ex illis ereptos Satanae ad Christum transferre valeret, Bd. 5, 9; S. 622, 19.
